integrity.computation_basis: exact finite binomial/rational checks and finite Gauss quadrature of jump variations
integrity.proof_basis: explicit analytic jump reduction, binomial prefix identity, inverse-denominator estimates, alternating Abel estimates and periodic integral

scientific_limitations: Each positive Floater–Hormann blending degree is held fixed as n tends to infinity; no uniformity in growing degree is claimed.
Equally spaced real one-dimensional nodes only; no nonuniform-grid or complex-data extension.
Leading sharp logarithmic growth and uniform jump profile, not exact finite-grid norm values or exact finite maximizer locations.
Unindexed older literature may contain an equivalent variation-norm formulation.
title: Universal logarithmic variation amplification for fixed-order Floater–Hormann interpolation
